executable.title: Label Transfer
executable.description: Perform label transfer for spatial transcriptomics data using reference datasets. Need to provide reference file if using KPMP Atlas Kidney organ option.
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

file.name: counts_file
file.label: Counts file
file.description: The counts file may be provided as an RDS file, an H5AD file, or the filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 file generated by the Space Ranger pipeline

string-enumeration.name: organ
string-enumeration.label: Organ
string-enumeration.description: Specify the organ reference to use which the tissue section belongs to (both WSI and 10x Visium data)

file.name: reference
file.label: KPMP Atlas Reference Path
file.description: Path to the KPMP Atlas reference data on local filesystem. ONLY required if "KPMP Atlas Kidney" is selected as Organ.

parameters.label: Girder API URL and Key
parameters.description: A Girder API URL and token for Girder client
